queue.title: Sales Engineer Oil Free Division
queue.description: Your role As a Sales Engineer within the Atlas Copco Oil Free Air (OFA) Division, your mission is to help industrial customers improve productivity, reduce operating costs, and achieve their sustainability goals through innovative utility and energy-efficient solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor, identifying opportunities across customers' entire utility infrastructure and delivering integrated solutions that drive operational excellence, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation. Your day-to-day Grow Atlas Copco's Oil Free Air and Total Utility Solutions business across your assigned territory through a combination of new business development and account management. Build strong relationships with customers across manufacturing, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, medical device, data centre, public sector and general industry sectors. Identify opportunities to improve customer productivity, reliability, energy efficiency and sustainability through compressed air and gas systems, heat recovery, heat pumps, steam compressors, chillers, cooling systems and other utility solutions. Conduct site surveys, energy assessments and system reviews to understand customer operations, challenges and future objectives. Develop a deep understanding of the customer's complete utility ecosystem and identify opportunities to optimise energy use across the entire facility. Inspire customers to think beyond individual equipment purchases and adopt a long-term utility strategy that delivers measurable improvements in operating costs, carbon reduction and operational performance. Promote and champion Atlas Copco's Total Utility Solutions approach by demonstrating how integrated technologies can maximise efficiency and accelerate decarbonisation objectives. Prepare and present compelling technical and commercial proposals that clearly communicate both financial and environmental value. Manage opportunities from initial engagement through solution development, project execution and successful handover, working closely with the Projects team and other internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Projects and Service colleagues to deliver a seamless and exceptional customer experience. Maintain an active and healthy sales pipeline through effective territory planning, prospecting and opportunity management. Act as a trusted advisor to customers by sharing industry best practice, energy-saving opportunities and Atlas Copco innovations. Your skills and experience We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role. An engineering qualification, technical apprenticeship, or equivalent industry experience. Previous experience in a sales, application engineering, business development or customer-facing technical role. Experience within compressed air, industrial equipment, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, automation, HVAC, process cooling, heat pumps, energy management, utilities or a related industry would be advantageous. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify opportunities, create value propositions and develop long-term customer relationships. An understanding of industrial energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives, carbon reduction strategies or utility optimisation would be advantageous. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities within a dynamic sales environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word, together with CRM systems. Full clean driving licence. Eligible to work in Ireland Your compensation and benefits The opportunity to join the global leader in compressed air and industrial productivity solutions. A newly created position within a growing business, providing the opportunity to make a real impact on the future success of the Oil Free Air division. A collaborative and supportive team environment with access to experienced colleagues across Sales, Projects and Service. Industry-leading products and technologies, including the most energy-efficient compressed air solutions, and innovative total utilities solutions in the market. Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, with continuous investment in your professional development. The freedom and autonomy to manage your territory and build long-term customer relationships. The backing of a global organisation with over 150 years of innovation and a strong commitment to employee development. A competitive salary and bonus package, company vehicle, laptop and smartphone. An attractive benefits package including pension, health insurance, life assurance and 25 days annual leave. Long-term career development opportunities within Atlas Copco Group. Salary Salary: €51,000 - €62,000 gross per annum, depending on skills, experience, and qualifications. Why this role is different This role is not focused on selling a single product line. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted partner to industrial customers, helping them reimagine how utilities are generated, recovered and consumed across their facilities. Success will come from identifying opportunities others miss, connecting technologies across multiple applications, and delivering meaningful reductions in both energy costs and CO₂ emissions while supporting our customers on their journey towards a more sustainable future. Application process Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us: Talent Acquisition: Rob Buckingham

You'll prospect for new business, drive every net new deal through our pipeline, and own the monthly sales KPIs that our leadership team runs the business on. You'll report to our Head of Growth & Marketing. You won't do every step of a sale yourself, but you'll make sure every step gets done. Our Senior Leadership Team (SLT) usually leads scoping, pricing and most presentations and pitches. Your job is to find the opportunities, keep each deal moving, and make sure nothing stalls between first contact and signing. As you build experience, you'll take on more of the pitching and closing yourself. You'll also be our main point of contact for Shopify, and make sure every sale of a partner tool is recorded so we receive the commission we're owed. You'll need to know ecommerce and Shopify well, be comfortable working to targets, and be the kind of person who keeps a CRM accurate because you want the numbers to be right. The role is fully remote, but you'll be out at events and meeting clients in person a few times a month. Most of that is in Ireland, with the odd trip abroad. AI and LLM tools are a big part of how we sell, so using them every day is a must. Key Responsibilities Net New Sales Work towards the net new revenue target, and contribute to the company revenue target across new and existing business. Prospect for new business, and build pipeline from referrals, Shopify, events, campaigns and inbound leads. Get back to new enquiries quickly, qualify them, and follow up every lead. Run intro and discovery calls, and to scope the work for initial indicative pricing. Coordinate scoping and pricing with our Senior Leadership Team (SLT), and keep it moving so proposals go out on time. Prepare proposals, and support the SLT on presentations and pitches until you're ready to lead them yourself. Follow up open proposals until there's a decision. Make sure signed projects are handed over to delivery with a clear, agreed scope. Existing Clients Support Account Managers and the wider team to get proposals for existing clients out on time. Make sure every existing-client opportunity is logged in the CRM, so the pipeline shows the full picture. Pipeline Admin & Sales KPIs Own the monthly sales KPIs, with the goal of closing every month at or above forecast. Follow up with internal teams throughout the month to get sales across the line, and flag early when the month is at risk of falling short. Keep the CRM accurate, realistic and up to date: stages, values, close dates and next steps on every deal. Keep the forecast current, and flag deals that are slipping early. Send weekly and monthly sales updates to the leadership team, and prepare the sales figures for the quarterly board report. Make sure signed work is set up correctly for delivery and invoicing, working with our finance team. Agree sales targets with the Head of Growth & Marketing, and take part in sales, marketing and product/services planning. Shopify & Partner Revenue Be Studio Forty9's main point of contact for Shopify, and own that partner relationship. Work with Shopify on referrals, joint opportunities and our standing in their partner programme. Make sure every sale of a partner tool or app is recorded, and that we receive the commission or referral fee that goes with it. Track partner commissions with our finance team, and chase anything that's missing. Events & Marketing Work with brand marketing on events, campaigns and sales materials that bring in qualified leads. Represent Studio Forty9 in person at our own events and industry events throughout the year. Follow up the leads that come from events and campaigns. Other partner relationships, such as co-marketing with technology partners, sit outside this role. How Success Is Measured Net new revenue Value of signed net new work against target Monthly sales KPIs Each month closed at or above forecast, with early warning given when it's at risk Pipeline Qualified pipeline for the next quarter against target Forecast accuracy How close the sales and invoices forecasts are to what we invoice and the sales that are confirmed Lead response How quickly new enquiries are contacted and qualified Partner revenue Shopify referrals won, and all partner tool commissions recorded and received Handover Projects reaching delivery with a clear, agreed scope Skills & Experience3+ years in B2 B sales or business development, ideally selling ecommerce, agency or Saa S services. A track record of building pipeline and contributing to new business targets. Good knowledge of ecommerce, and working knowledge of Shopify (required). Experience prospecting and moving deals through a sales process, from first contact to signed proposal.
